source_title: TempusDirect Announces Strategic Investment from Aldrich Capital Partners to Accelerate Growth and Innovation in Claims Cost Containment - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
MCLEAN, Va. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TempusDirect, a technology-enabled provider of third-party claims cost containment solutions serving the property and casualty ("P&C") insurance industry, today announced a strategic investment from Aldrich Capital Partners ("ACP"), a private equity firm focused on investing in technology-driven business services companies with strong leadership teams and significant growth potential.
The investment will support TempusDirect's next phase of growth as the Company continues to scale its technology platform, expand its market presence, and enhance its service capabilities. TempusDirect plans to invest in product development, client services, and business development, while advancing automation and technology-driven efficiencies across its suite of solutions. These initiatives will further strengthen the Company's ability to deliver faster, drive meaningful cost savings, and offer exceptional service to its insurance carrier partners.
"We founded TempusDirect ten years ago believing there was a better way to help insurance carriers manage the complexity and rising costs of third-party claims. Our success has been built on delivering measurable value to our clients, developing innovative solutions, and assembling an exceptional team. Our partnership with Aldrich marks an exciting next chapter, providing the resources and strategic support to accelerate innovation, expand our capabilities, and deliver even greater value to our carrier partners," said Greg Gaughan, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder of TempusDirect.
TempusDirect offers a comprehensive suite of three complementary solutions designed to address critical cost containment needs across the third-party claims lifecycle. Its bill validation and benchmarking solution leverages proprietary claims data to evaluate medical charges and establish defensible benchmarks for attorney-represented claims. Its direct provider negotiation solution facilitates the resolution of medical bills for unrepresented claimants through direct engagement with healthcare providers. Additionally, its demand package review solution provides carriers with a data-driven assessment of medical expenses presented in attorney-represented claims at the demand stage. Together, these integrated capabilities enable insurers to make more informed claims decisions, manage growing claims costs, and accelerate resolution while maintaining consistency and efficiency throughout the claims process.
"Operational excellence and responsive service have been at the core of TempusDirect from day one. As carrier demand for our solutions continues to grow, this investment allows us to expand our capacity, continue innovating across our platform, and keep delivering the speed and accuracy our partners rely on," said Josh Dickerson, Chief Operating Officer and Co-Founder of TempusDirect.
"We're excited to back Greg, Josh, and the talented team they've built at TempusDirect," said Raz Zia, Managing Partner at Aldrich Capital Partners. "We are active investors in industry specific business services companies and TempusDirect's tech-enabled solution for the insurance market really stood out. Customers and industry experts consistently pointed to the clear, demonstrable return TempusDirect delivers. We see a significant opportunity to build on that foundation by expanding the platform's capabilities, having the ACP AI team deploy more advanced capabilities for clients and serving an even broader set of customers in the years ahead."
TempusDirect is a technology-enabled provider of third-party claims cost containment solutions serving the U.S. property and casualty insurance industry. Powered by a proprietary database of historical claims data across multiple insurance carriers, the Company helps insurers validate and benchmark medical bills, negotiate provider settlements, and evaluate demand packages to reduce claims costs and improve resolution efficiency. Founded in 2016, TempusDirect is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. For more information, visit www.tempusdirect.com .
Aldrich Capital Partners is a private equity firm that partners with technology-driven businesses led by exceptional management teams. The firm combines growth capital with strategic and operational support to help companies accelerate innovation, scale their operations, and realize their long-term growth potential. For more information, visit www.aldrichcap.com .
